_comment: The newcomer's cards, and their words. Edit freely: scripts/presentation/welcome_panel.gd only lays them out. Order of play for a brand-new player: 'welcome' (shows their starting look) -> the wardrobe -> 'find' (as the search for their companion begins; also after New Companion, or if they left mid-search) -> bonding -> the Gateway appears (gateway_reveal_hint) -> 'explore'. Each card: eyebrow (small caps), heading, body (short paragraphs), optional tip (small print), button (its button's label), optional show_avatar (a live portrait of the player). The gear menu's Welcome replays 'reread_order', ending on 'reread_button'.

welcome.heading: A place to be, not a task.
body: Kithbound is a gentle world to wander, linger in, and share with friends. There's nothing to win and no way to lose.
This is you. Make yourself at home: you can change your look any time from the gear menu.

find.heading: This world is better with a companion.
body: Everyone here is bound to one creature: a partner who follows you everywhere, shifts its shape now and then, and slowly grows to reflect who you are.
Yours is out there among the wild ones nearby. Walk up close and Examine them. You'll know yours when you find it.
find.tip: Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or the on-screen stick. Space or Enter (or the Examine bubble) looks at what's near you.

explore.heading: Now go explore.
body: The great Gateway opens onto other worlds, and each one hides a secret.
What you find is written in your journal, and your home grows with it. Bring friends: it's all better together.

gateway_reveal_hint: And where the meadow ended, a great gate breathes itself into being.
